paragraphs.text:
“This is the demented scholar who led the rebirth of the cult, 
though the seed had slept there down through the millennia, 
waiting a foul spurt of evil to give it rise. Now the cult performs 
its evil rituals throughout the land, worshiping not Aten but the 
evil ones who pose as his priests.” Return to 253.
